identity.notes: The six-byte advertised network id selects the owner's cached network document; unit addresses and topology stay private.

discovery.none: Manual family/generation selection is required because this spec and the Evolution spec would otherwise both match FE4D plus company 963. The protocol_details.advertisements grammar is not an automatic selector. After selection, the 13-byte connection-info protocol byte (or an already trusted cache plus subsequent read) must confirm 5–9; never select both generations from one scan.

identification.notes: FE4D and company 0x03c3 are deliberately NOT automatic matchers: they are shared with Evolution and the generic matcher cannot decode the low-five- bit generation field. Manually select the Casambi family and intended generation, then require the post-connect full-session read to confirm protocol 5–9 before any signed write. FE3D advertisements and legacy 5a ca records remain outside this profile.

device.name: Casambi Classic BLE lighting networks (protocols 5–9)
device.notes:
SCOPE: the app-corroborated full-network Classic API for network protocols 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 using company id 0x03c3, service FE4D and the new characteristic UUID scheme. Network protocol, fixture firmware number and firmware grade are independent; a Classic 26.x image does not by itself prove a network protocol version.
CLASSIC IS NOT EVOLUTION-LITE. Classic payloads are not encrypted. Visitor frames carry a four-byte AES-CMAC and manager frames a sixteen-byte CMAC; that authenticates plaintext but supplies no confidentiality. Do not send Evolution NodeInfo, P-256, AES-CTR or type-7 invocations to Classic.
The separate CasambiDevice/direct API writes one-byte opcodes to FE3D or FE4D characteristics and documents a different nonce/sequence story. FE3D was not found in the reviewed vendor app and that path was not independently validated here, so it is excluded, including its direct golden opcodes. Legacy CA5A/CA52-family framing is also excluded because the recovered legacy Classic header is internally uncertain pending capture.
A full client needs cloud-provisioned visitor/manager keys, topology and fixture controls once, then operates offline only from a complete compatible warm cache. This project's generic mobile app cannot execute the custom session/CMAC/target protocol, hence identify_only.

openness.notes: Casambi does not publish this full-session wire protocol. The pinned public implementation is not official documentation, and its separate direct-device API is outside this spec.

enter_pairing_mode.notes: No physical pairing window is used for an already provisioned network. Cloud-issued visitor/manager keys authorize the application-layer CMAC.

exclusivity.notes: The pinned direct-client documentation says one central, but this project did not establish a universal full-session per-node limit.
exclusivity.recovery: Close the other Casambi/BLE central if the session cannot connect. No OS bond needs clearing; reconnect and reread the connection hash instead of reusing a sequence.

pairing.notes: No BLE bonding is required. CMAC authenticates a shared network role, not a unique client identity, and the four-byte visitor tag is short; protect keys and do not mistake integrity for confidentiality.

unpair.clears: Fixture membership in a Classic mesh; not an OS Bluetooth bond and not necessarily a hardware reset.
unpair.notes: Unpair uses manager-keyed management frame type 2 on characteristic 0002. A unit foreign to the current network needs fixture/unpair (not Evolution's /v2 route) before that write; offline third-party foreign unpair is unavailable.

issued_to_client: 16-byte visitorKey used for ordinary frames, truncated to a four-byte CMAC
Optional 16-byte managerKey used for administrative frames, full sixteen-byte CMAC
Complete protocol/topology/fixture cache and per-connection eight-byte connection hash
credentials.notes: Classic JSON caches still contain plaintext hex keys and session data. Use intended 0700 directories and 0600 files, preserve the whole same-version directory, and never publish a backup. Legacy pickle files are ignored by the pinned JSON client, not migrated or interchangeable.
stored_on_device: Classic mesh membership and fixture/network configuration
Network authorization material for visitor and manager roles

factory_reset.description: Do not substitute arbitrary power cycling, controller-cache deletion or ESP32 clearconfig for fixture reset. Partner hardware may have its own procedure, which must be established per model.
factory_reset.effect: No vendor-independent physical reset or exact cleared-state list is established. Classic command type 53 is a manager-authorized network Reset operation, not evidence of a universal hardware factory reset.

methods.description: Use a trusted cache with protocol 5–9, visitor key and optional manager key, full units/groups/scenes and unexpired fixture controls. A cached network id or password alone is not sufficient.

steps.action: Validate cache version 4 or the client's supported equivalent, protocol 5–9, visitor key, complete topology and every unexpired fixture control definition.
steps.expect: All required key, topology and fixture files are present; no network request is needed.

steps.action: Read the Classic connection hash on 0001, subscribe, sign and send the initial version packet with a nonzero 16-bit sequence, then accept only protocol 5–9 state traffic.
steps.expect: A valid full session with CMAC-verifiable commands and fixture-aware state; no ECDH exchange occurs.

cloud.local_alternative: Only after a complete compatible cache exists. No independent cloud replacement or offline first-time key/topology provisioner was found.

GET /network/uuid/<uuid> to resolve the id, POST /network/<id>/session with password/deviceName, then PUT /network/<id>/ with formatVersion/deviceName/revision and X-Casambi-Session; apply the returned status/revision rules and persist the Classic JSON cache and every fixture definition.

steps.action: Disconnect from the cloud and verify the full BLE session using only cached material; do not validate setup with a direct opcode write.

causes: A fixture definition is absent/expired or cache versions differ; topology alone does not satisfy the offline boundary.

causes: Wrong connection hash, key selector, key role, sequence byte order or use of direct/legacy frames instead of this full-session envelope.

setup.notes: This setup authorizes a full-network controller; it does not provision a direct FE3D device or create a network offline. Public full-session clients implement protocols 5–9, but this project did not run them on hardware.

rejoin.notes: An authorized controller reconnects by rereading the connection hash and starting a fresh sequence; moving a fixture between meshes requires manager-authorized unpair and recommissioning. Foreign fixtures need a cloud-issued unpair key and the official guided recovery.

steps.action: Before losing the old network or controller, share it and preserve the complete versioned Classic cache, including manager key if ownership operations will be needed.
Unpair an owned fixture with manager authorization, or use the official foreign-device recovery to obtain authorization, then recommission with the vendor app.
steps.expect: The old mesh releases the unit before it joins another; no factory reset is assumed.

testing.notes: No fixture was scanned, connected, reset, unpaired, upgraded or controlled by this project, and no Casambi account or owner network was accessed. Facts are reported from static app analysis and the pinned full-session Classic client. Golden vectors are public synthetic/derived fixtures; upstream captured labels are not independent verification by this project.

entities.name: Classic mesh light (per cached unit)
entities.notes: Descriptive only while identify_only. A bespoke consumer uses cached targets and fixture controls, wraps each operation in the correct role/ sequence/CMAC envelope and parses plaintext state. No direct opcode or fixed generic GATT command is bound.

evidence.app_static_analysis: Vendor Android app v3.20.2 supplied the complete Classic path: protocol selection, new UUID map, eight-byte connection hash, selector/CMAC/sequence, operation records/types, state/direct-state, management, cloud keys and OTA. It establishes that Classic is not confined to an old third-party fork. Legacy-header output is internally uncertain and therefore excluded.

evidence.open_questions: Capture the legacy Classic header, validate foreign recovery and OTA block/ signature behavior on sacrificial hardware, resolve Classic location sync, and reconcile bit-7 state semantics with a redacted full-session capture.
evidence.public_fixtures: The pinned client's golden_vectors.json supplied only relevant full-session crypto and operation entries. Public fixture/1 supplied the one-byte dimmer layout. Upstream captured labels remain third-party claims, not hardware confirmation by this project.
evidence.public_implementation: hellqvio86/casambi-classic-ble at 98ebe25bd95897c24ee471c5f011dfaf62ecda12 corroborates protocols 5–9, 13-byte connection info, four/sixteen-byte CMAC, 16-bit big-endian sequence with zero skipped, operation records, JSON cache and malformed-state handling. Its direct CasambiDevice API is separate and excluded. Its incoming bit-7 online naming is not allowed to override the app-corroborated on semantics recorded here.

dfu_mode.notes: No distinct update-mode name/service/address offset is established. FE4D also identifies normal operation and does not prove a bootloader.

initialization.description: Read c9ffde48-ca5a-0001-ab83-8f519b482f77; retain the first eight bytes as connection hash, and when present parse the five gateway fields through byte 13. Reject full-session protocols outside 5–9.

initialization.notes: Notifications are plaintext Classic state/config/response records, not Evolution encrypted packets.

initialization.description: Using sequence 1, sign payload 00 01 0b with the connection hash and the operation's role key, write the new-scheme envelope with response, then increment nonzero 16-bit sequences for later full-session records.

fields.description: low 6 bits operation type; bit 6 origin follows; bit 7 target follows
fields.name: type_flags

fields.description: Outgoing command origin, rolls through 1..255; independent of 16-bit envelope sequence
fields.name: origin

command_records.length_and_marker: Total record length 4..16 bytes; first byte = 0xf0 | (total_length - 1). The same f0 nibble marks responses in the other direction.
malformed_rules: Require the f0 length marker, 4..16 total bytes, origin, any flagged target and lifetime; reject truncated or trailing data rather than guessing a shorter payload.
Validate operation/target combinations and exact payload lengths before signing. SetTemperature/Color/Vertical/White do not accept scene targets in the pinned full-session map.

identify_input.payload: input identifier; locate is not advanced

reset.payload: network Reset operation, not a universal hardware reset

scene_level.payload: level:u8; specialized scene restore uses level || 00 00 01

test_unpair.payload: unpair test; not a factory reset

command_records.outgoing_flags: Set bit 6 (origin) always; set bit 7 for unit/group/scene targets, clear for whole-network targets

scalar_encodings.color: r, g, b each uint8 0..255 in that order; Classic full-session color is RGB, not Evolution HS
scalar_encodings.restore_on: ff 01 00 00 01 for ordinary unit/group/network restore; scene-level specialized form is level || 00 00 01. Do not use Evolution ff 05.

temperature.encoding: floor(kelvin / 50); reject negative and above 12750 K, and enforce fixture min/max

scene_color.compatibility_boundary: The app enum names this type, but the pinned outgoing OperationsContextClassic map rejects every SetColor scene target; do not emit it from this profile

scene_temperature.compatibility_boundary: The app enum names this type, but the pinned outgoing OperationsContextClassic map rejects every SetTemperature scene target; do not emit it from this profile

direct_state.flags_and_length: Low nibble = state-vector length; bit 6 means scene_id follows; other bits are not a generic command mask
malformed_rules: Require unit id, flags/length, optional scene id and exactly the declared state length; reject any trailing or truncated bytes.
State bytes must also equal the cached fixture state_length before semantic decoding or read-modify-write.

exclusions.direct_api: Excluded. Raw direct opcodes 01/02/03/04/05/07/0f/10/11/14/81/82, MD5 password payloads, one-byte sequence claims and FE3D characteristics are a materially different API. Direct golden vectors are not reused here.
exclusions.evolution: Only protocols 10–11 route to casambi-evolution-ble.yaml after post-connect confirmation; protocol 12 and newer are unsupported pending validation, and no version >=10 is ever Classic
exclusions.legacy_uuid_scheme: Excluded pending capture. The recovered legacy Classic builder appears to overwrite its own type/MAC slot, so CA5A service and CA52/CA51/CA50/CA53 characteristic framing is not asserted. New-scheme facts do not resolve it.

fixture_cache.format: Classic JSON cache version 4 or a documented compatible equivalent
fixture_cache.offline_boundary: A complete warm compatible cache only; force_offline may still request a missing or 28-day-expired fixture, so cached network id alone proves nothing

board_1.notes: Anonymous public fixture, not an owner network. A Classic firmware offer does not itself prove the mesh protocol version.

required_files: <network-id>.json with protocol, units, groups and scenes
casambi_lookup.json with plaintext visitorKey and optional managerKey
casambi_types.json with every unexpired fixture definition
fixture_cache.security: Atomic writes and intended 0700/0600 permissions; legacy keys.pck/session.pck/types.pck are ignored, not migrated as objects

special_first_bytes.0: Network configuration chunk; queue only after checking chunk sequencing, not unit state
special_first_bytes.240: Response: f0 | responding_unit | origin | remaining state bytes
special_first_bytes.255: ASCII debug log; never publish as state

incoming_state.transport_security: No CMAC and no envelope sequence/replay protection on raw configuration, debug, response or unit-state notifications; do not call verify_envelope for these records or imply authenticated state

fields.description: low nibble state length; bit 4 source flag; bit 5 level extra; bit 6 source extra; bit 7 on (app-corroborated)
fields.name: flags

malformed_rules: Reject empty/truncated headers, missing level/source extras and short state vectors; never emit a partial unit update.
Decode state vectors only with the cached fixture. Raw bytes may be retained without it, but names, engineering units and SetState are blocked.
unit_record.on_flag: Bit 7 is the app-corroborated on flag. The pinned Python client labels it online and hardcodes on=True; that naming discrepancy is not copied into this spec's semantics.

hardware_config.advanced_reason: Model-specific hardware configuration was not exercised

time_sync.reported_layout: 07 | year:u16be | month/day/hour/minute/second:u8 | timezone_offset_minutes:u16be | next_dst_transition:u32be | dst_change_minutes:u8 | latitude[3] | longitude[3] | reserved:u16be | microseconds:u24be | latitude_high:u8
time_sync.unresolved_coordinate_rule: The Classic three-byte coordinate words and final latitude-high byte require capture before generating location sync; do not borrow Evolution's two int32 fixed-point fields. A client may omit time/location sync rather than send a guessed location.

unpair.advanced_reason: Removes mesh ownership and can strand fixtures without a complete shared backup

ota.advanced_reason: Writes fixture firmware; wrong generation/board/CPU/grade/variant or interruption can leave lighting unavailable
ota.block_transfer: PREPARE 01 with metadata/signature, BEGIN 02 with first 16 block bytes after replacing first four with little-endian block CRC-32, DATA 03 fragments <=MTU-4, COMMIT 04, indexed notifications, final APPLY 05 without response
ota.container: 0xca5a0002 | outer CRC-32:u32be over remainder | version/device/board/flags/block_count:u16be | typed blocks | addon:u16be | 64-byte trailer
ota.conversion: Classic operation type 16 executes Extended Upgrade with manager authorization. Evolution cannot be rolled back as a network; every device must be unpaired, individually restored to Classic and commissioned into a new Classic network.
ota.image_verification: Validate outer reflected IEEE CRC-32 and exact block/container lengths. The app checks CRC only; trailer algorithm/trust key and node enforcement are unknown.
ota.recovery: Update-mode identity, bad-CRC response and interrupted-update result are unknown; never apply a partial image or assume Nordic DFU behavior

scope.post_connect_confirmation: Manually select generation, then require full-session connection-info protocol 5–9 before signed writes
scope.version_boundary: Below 5 is unsupported by the conformant full-session client; 10–11 route to Evolution after confirmation; 12 and newer are unsupported pending validation, never Classic

security.confidentiality: None: connection hash, sequence, type and command/state payload remain plaintext

incoming_notifications.handling: Raw configuration, debug, response and unit-state notifications have no CMAC and no envelope-sequence replay protection. Parse them as unauthenticated plaintext with strict lengths/context and fresh-state plausibility, never claim verify-before-parse CMAC authentication or replay rejection.

none.use: hardware-config and explicitly unauthenticated management only

security.replay_boundary: Signed writes have only the eight-byte per-connection hash plus nonzero 16-bit sequence; short visitor tag/shared keys are weak replay protection. Incoming notifications have no protocol-level replay defense.
security.verification: For signed envelopes/writes only, recompute CMAC and compare in constant time before parsing the enclosed command; a valid tag does not hide payload from a listener

envelope.cmac_output: visitor first 4 bytes, manager all 16 bytes; selector byte itself is excluded from CMAC input
envelope.command_records: Ordinary operation records follow sequence directly with no frame-type byte; direct state batch uses frame type 6; unpair management uses frame type 2
malformed_rules: Reject unsupported selectors, insufficient MAC/sequence bytes, sequence zero and any CMAC mismatch before decoding a command.
Keep envelope sequence separate from command origin. Do not use the direct API's one-byte sequence or put the selector in the MAC input.
envelope.no_mac: Selector 1 has no MAC bytes; sequence and payload remain present
envelope.sequence_range: 1..65535; skip 0000, so 65535 is followed by 1 on a continuing session

malformed_rules: Require 8 bytes for phone-direct or exactly 13 for the gateway form; reject other lengths, zero MTU and protocols outside 5–9.
Connection hash is not ECDH material and is not stable across reconnects. Never substitute NodeInfo's 16-byte nonce.

startup.completion: After the signed startup write, accept Classic state/config/response records and send full command records; no key exchange acknowledgement or encrypted state follows
startup.role: visitor for ordinary session startup; manager only for an administrative queue

direct_state.note: Fresh unit-5 direct-state record with scene id 12 and the public one-byte Board dimmer state 0x80.

incoming_state.note: Fresh two-byte opaque state only; fixture semantics require the cached layout and are not guessed from aabb.

test_vectors.operation_encoding_note: These are operation records before the separate Classic envelope; target_type None in the upstream fixture is spelled network here.
test_vectors.provenance: crypto_session_vectors and classic_session_operations are the relevant public full-session entries from hellqvio86/casambi-classic-ble commit 98ebe25bd95897c24ee471c5f011dfaf62ecda12, fixtures/golden_vectors.json. Their keys, hashes, ids and payloads are synthetic fixtures, not owner material. The independent stdlib test rebuilds all.

remaining_unknowns: Legacy UUID-scheme Classic frame header and protocols below 5; no legacy commands are claimed.
Direct FE3D/FE4D raw-opcode API interoperability and its distinct challenge/sequence format; excluded rather than merged.
Classic three-byte location coordinate packing and final latitude-high byte for time sync.
Bit-7 on semantics versus the pinned client's online naming needs a redacted app-session capture.
Foreign-fixture offline unpair, universal physical reset, cache conversion and lost-credential recovery.
OTA signature/trust key, block acknowledgement/CRC rejection, update-mode identity and interruption recovery.

characteristics.name: Classic full-session control and notifications
characteristics.notes: Reads return the eight-byte connection hash, optionally followed by unit/flags/MTU/protocol/flags-high. Writes carry selector || CMAC || sequence:u16be || optional type || payload. Notifications are not encrypted: 00 config, ff debug, f0 response, or unit-state records.

characteristics.name: Classic management
characteristics.notes: Time sync uses visitor CMAC; unpair type 2 uses manager CMAC; hardware-config request 01 05 uses selector 1 without a MAC. These operations have role and safety prerequisites, not fixed public writes.

characteristics.name: Casambi Classic OTA channel
characteristics.notes: Advanced vendor-image transfer. The container and block protocol are shared with Evolution but Classic images and Classic-to-Evolution conversion images are separate selections and must not be mixed.

services.name: Casambi Classic full-session service (new UUID scheme)
services.notes: Classic uses write-with-response by default and the default ATT MTU 23; larger frames may switch to write-without-response within the negotiated budget. No characteristic commands are declared because the CMAC, connection hash, sequence, target and fixture context are not generic.
